'''Rafe''' was an individual living during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. On his last job, Rafe's [[Rafe's partner|partner]] sneaked into a fancy dinner party leaving his usual protective [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] behind. Since that day, Rafe had never gone without his own protection.
